text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—I decline.
I have a mountain of research reports to deal with, you see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "You see" your ass! Your actual brother's wedding is way more important than that crap!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? That's news to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even so, how strange. Why send an invitation to a younger sister he sees maybe once a year, if that...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: 'Cause you're family, moron! Quit yer whining and at least show up for the ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
*Siiiiiiiiiiiiigh*.
To think I would actually be dragged into attending this...

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: —Ugh, she's actually here...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? Well, well, well, well! If it isn't my dear little brother! It's been quite a while, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fumu... You've grown taller than I remember. About time for you to enter your secondary growth period, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The growth curves between umamusume and humans differ considerably. This naturally leads to discrepancies in physical capability, which means...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You make for a prime specimen. For starters, let me collect a full set of your physical data. Now then, sit down right over there and—

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Like hell I will! Get away from me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a shame. So Elder Sister is still on her way from the airport? And here I was hoping to have the entire family drink the test reagents all at once.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Tachyon.
Don't you have something to say to your brother first?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, congratulations on your wedding, Brother. May you two enjoy lasting happiness.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. ...I never expected you would actually come.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I had zero intention of coming, truly. But a meddlesome friend caught sight of the invitation, which marked the end of my luck.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my research schedule is in shambles. And it was already congested enough as it is...

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Older Brother
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case, I'll do my best to make sure everything proceeds without delay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Splendid. Please do.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, I shall be reviewing some academic papers in the corner. Feel free to call for me when it's time to move.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Always the same, that girl.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Guests moving to the banquet hall, please proceed this way...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew... Finally over. Now, to head back and tackle those reports...

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Relative
text_block_list.text: —Hold on, Tachyon-chan. Don't you think that's a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Relative
text_block_list.text: It's your own brother's wedding, you know? Just for today, you could put your research aside and cherish some time with your family...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Relative
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why, you ask?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Why should I bother doing something like that?
Is there any benefit in it for me?

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Relative
text_block_list.text: Benefit? That's not what this is about...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely what it is about.
At least, for me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, if you will excuse me.
Until next time, dear family members.
One day, I ran into Agnes Tachyon in front of the school gate, dressed in formal attire.
choice_data_list: Are you coming back from a celebration?
On your way back from some celebration?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thanks to that, I haven't been able to do proper research all day, which leaves me thoroughly dispirited.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so! My good friend!
Could you drink this for me? Come on, bottom's up!
Despite finding it suspicious, I was overwhelmed by her momentum and downed the contents of the test tube in one gulp...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! This is spectacular!
You're glowing with rainbow colors!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let us conduct various verifications in that state!
Now, let's go, my rainbow guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho...! Your face is turning blue right before my very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies.
I did not examine or refine the taste whatsoever.
I tend to put off any entertainment that takes place before it enters the stomach, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, the dark circles under your eyes have vanished.
It seems to be effective against fatigue.
...Well, let's call that a minor success.
